summary: Sum exactly three already normalized inverse-length elastic collision coefficients Omega=nu/Vth in caller channel order.

capability: Sum exactly three already normalized inverse-length elastic collision coefficients Omega=nu/Vth in caller channel order.
operation: three caller-ordered channel profiles -> one total profile
discovery.model: the channel confluence; normalized spatial transport with u=v/Vth and inverse-length collision coefficients
discovery.geometry: none; a pointwise reduction over caller-declared shapes; velocity axes are dimensionless u=v/Vth on one common caller normalization
discovery.boundary: exactly three non-empty finite equal-shape profiles

identity.relation: Omega_total = Omega_1 + Omega_2 + Omega_3 pointwise over equal-shape channel profiles
identity.direction: three caller-ordered channel profiles -> one total profile
identity.definition: The three channels are added left to right in caller order (float summation order preserved); exactly three channels are admitted
identity.geometry: none; a pointwise reduction over caller-declared shapes
identity.coordinates: All channel coefficients and the sum are in m^-1, using one common caller thermal-speed normalization.
identity.boundary: exactly three non-empty finite equal-shape profiles
assumptions: The three-channel count defines one species family's elastic pairs; other counts are rejected.
Channels are expected nonnegative by physics, but only finiteness is enforced.
Three 1e308 channels would overflow to inf; this asset fail-closes on a non-finite total instead, per the declared finite-output contract. A regression test pins that behaviour.

The public transport convention is u=v/Vth on one caller-selected thermal-speed scale: alpha=nu/Vth has units m^-1, F integrates over normalized velocity volume to number density in m^-3, and every spatial source coefficient is Q/Vth in F/m. Physical rates in s^-1 must be divided by that same Vth before this spatial operator; no automatic conversion is performed.

inputs.name: frequency_profiles_m_inv
inputs.description: Exactly three elastic coefficient profiles Omega_q=nu_q/Vth, all normalized with the same Vth.
inputs.constraints: Exactly three non-empty finite arrays of one common shape, in caller order.

outputs.name: elastic_frequency_m_inv
outputs.description: Summed inverse-length elastic coefficient for spatial transport.
outputs.constraints: Finite; equals the pointwise sum in the declared order.

preconditions: Three finite equal-shape caller-normalized channel profiles.
Use one common Vth for normalized velocity nodes, inverse-length collision coefficients and spatial source coefficients; the callable performs no implicit unit conversion.
supported: Confluence of the species-pair elastic Omega channels on one shared grid.
excluded: Fewer or more than three channels; mismatched shapes; non-finite values.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when the channel count is not three, any channel is empty, shapes differ, or any value is non-real or non-finite; implicit boolean, string and complex conversion is rejected.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the evaluation produces a non-finite result where the contract demands finiteness; no fallback is selected.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

example.description: Sum three channels pointwise, confirm zero channels pass through, and reject contract violations.
example.expected: Observed PASS: The pointwise sum in caller order; a two-channel call is rejected.

scope: Direct tests bind caller addition order, a zero channel, channel-count/shape validation, implicit-real rejection and overflowing-total rejection.
The cross-domain tests divide three prescribed physical elastic frequencies by the common Vth, aggregate their regenerated source and recover the physical source in the RHS.
The contract example covers one bounded representative call; numerical checks do not establish external physical validation or full-domain applicability.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to the stated normalized transport relation. Direct tests bind caller addition order, a zero channel, channel-count/shape validation, implicit-real rejection and overflowing-total rejection. The cross-domain tests divide three prescribed physical elastic frequencies by the common Vth, aggregate their regenerated source and recover the physical source in the RHS. The listed direct and cross-domain tests are the current reproducible evidence; the example exercises one bounded call. Independent analytic and SI-unit comparisons are limited to the stated fixtures. Unbound historical source/parity receipts remain UNKNOWN and are not re-established here.
known_limitations: No external collision-data calibration, source-project parity qualification or device-specific physical validation is established by these tests.
The normalization tests use bounded aligned meshes and prescribed rates; they do not certify full-distribution grid convergence, arbitrary-step positivity or the complete nonlinear transport model.
